Supporting information for the paper: Bedard, D., Fortier R., Lemieux J-M., Allard, G., Roche, A., Parenteau-Thibault M., Locat, J., Dupuis, C.J., Arel, J., Fournier, T. and Michaud, H. (2026) Study of ground subsidence due to internal erosion in sands using ground penetrating radar profiling and induced polarization tomography.

Contains additional ground penetrating radar and induced polarization tomography data and the 3D geological model. Information about the data can be found in the files : metadata.pdf and metadata-1.pdf.
